title: The runstate git-maintenance fixture fails on this host at base, blocking a clean full-suite run
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) fails on this host because a plain `git fetch` starts no auto-maintenance, so the armed fixture proves nothing; I reproduced it at the base commit ce5e873e on a clean clone, and the learnings already record this fixture failing at base across yoh and being filed four times in gvc. It makes every full `make test` one test red, which trains workers to skip reading full-suite output.
